the yeast biofilm development is slow, and that the bacteria rapidly invade the yeast biofilm.

a better understanding of the mechanisms of biofilm development and of the interactions between the microorganisms in the mixed community.
the study of the interactions between yeast and bacteria in a continuous process, in particular the development of yeast and bacterial biofilms and their competition.

the yeast strain used in this study was not resistant to bacterial contamination and that the biofilm structure was not stable in the presence of bacteria.
the yeast biofilm is invaded by the bacteria and that this invasion is favoured by the yeast biofilm growth rate.
the yeast biofilm is not resistant to the bacterial invasion and is not an efficient barrier to prevent the bacterial contamination.
